rv.q: A lunatic farce that's as black as a policeman's hat, 'The Ladykillers' is as irresistible as ever.
With a little extra pace, this highly entertaining revival will match the original.
All told The Ladykillers is a perfectly enjoyable way to wile away a summer's evening, though it struggles to match the accomplishment and charm of its source.
This approach deprives the tale of all its subtlety and shadowy strangeness.
It is a slightly chaotic but overall enjoyable performance with some laugh out loud moments.

cn.t: This anarchic adaptation of the Ealing classic delivers fast-paced slapstick and a jaw-dropping revolving set, though critics split on whether the broad, chaotic humor enhances or abandons the original's nuance.
